name: T. Hawk
title: La garde des deux paumes
prompt: Edit this existing Kalistar illustration of adult T. Hawk from Street Fighter. Change his fighting guard to his characteristic TWO FLAT OPEN HANDS stance. Both hands are open and fully flattened, fingers naturally extended and held together, with straight natural wrists: one open hand extended forward at upper chest height, the second open flat hand slightly closer to his body at a lower chest height, both palms broadly facing downward in a poised guarding stance. No grasping/claw fingers, no fists, no twisted wrists. This should read as T. Hawk's iconic poised two-flat-hand fighting guard, not reaching to grab. Reposition forearms and elbows as needed with accurate long muscular human anatomy. Preserve the same face, long dark hair, Thunderfoot headband and feathers, sleeveless blue denim outfit, turquoise adornments, body build, grounded stance, quiet rocky plateau, painterly colours and lighting. Keep vertical 4:5 composition, natural proportions and breathe around his silhouette. A hand may extend beyond the canvas edge rather than being distorted to fit. Premium narrative hand-painted Kalistar finish, rich brush texture, not photoreal or smooth CGI, no words or frame. Do not add background clutter.
